# T-3: Validate integration upgrade evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make integration gate require upgrade evidence only when changed source paths require upgrade.

## Acceptance Criteria
- src/skills/** changes require valid upgrade evidence.
- src/presets/** changes require valid upgrade evidence.
- Other changed paths do not require upgrade evidence.
- Failed or malformed upgrade evidence blocks integration gate with a message containing `upgrade-result.json exitCode=<value> result=<value>` for failed artifacts.

## Implementation Notes
Reuse existing git diff changed-file collection and artifact trust failure reporting. Keep existing required test trust inputs unchanged.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests with `// spec: R4 R5 R6` simulate changed path sets and artifact states, then assert gate trust validation outcomes.
